title: Senior Project Manager
description:
About the role:

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems, from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids. Our Forward Deployed engineers bring it into real production environments with international customers and delivery partners.

As Senior Project Manager, you help steer that work. You keep projects on track from POC to production, give team leads a clear picture to decide which projects to take on, and ensure that what we build for one customer flows back into the platform. You work at the staff level alongside product management and technical leadership, and take on whatever else the department needs as it grows. Expect a fast-moving environment where the processes are still being shaped, and you help shape them.

Responsibilities:

• Coordinate the Forward Deployed project landscape, and prepare prioritization decisions with the team leads by strategic value, technical risk, and commercial return

• Plan scope, milestones, and engineer allocation together with the team leads, and make the trade-offs visible when capacity is tight

• Drive engagements from POC through pilot to production, including on-site commissioning and acceptance

• Act as a key point of contact for customers and delivery partners, with a clear interface between their scope and ours

• Support Sales and Pre-Sales with feasibility assessments and effort estimates

• Coordinate across product teams and AI research without direct line authority

• Make sure features built for customer projects are fed back into the platform as standard capabilities

• Set up lightweight ways of working for planning and reporting that fit how the teams actually work

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager – Data Product Marketplace, Defense & Systems
description:
Job Description Summary
Operationalizes the Data Product Marketplace and enterprise catalog for Defense & Systems. The role manages, facilitates, and monitors the flow of data products from intake through to being consumable in the fabric: onboarding and certification intake, the catalog and discovery experience, self-service access workflows, and the adoption metrics that show whether any of it is working.
Standards come from the Principal Data Architect in the form of data-product contracts, schemas, and SLAs; policy comes from the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager. This role executes within both and owns the day-to-day consumer experience. Success improves Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost by shortening the path from a data product request to a governed, usable data product. Job Description
Why this role
The Data Fabric only matters if people use it, and that is what this role owns: the front door, the onboarding path, and the evidence of adoption. You will work directly with data product owners across Defense & Systems, run the intake process that moves products into the fabric, and hold the consumer experience to a standard. This is hands-on product management on a platform being built now, not caretaking of one already built.

Marketplace and catalog ownership

• Own the marketplace and catalog feature backlog: search and discovery experience, data-product previews, and self-service access workflows

• Prioritize and sequence the backlog against adoption impact and the enterprise roadmap set by the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager

• Maintain catalog completeness and data passport currency as products are published, enhanced, and deprecated
Data product onboarding and certification

• Manage data-product onboarding and certification intake, working the checklist and action plan alongside Data Product Owners

• Define product specifications with owners: SLAs, uptime targets, health scores, and critical data elements

• Partner with the Principal Data Architect to return certification and onboarding decisions within the defined SLA

• Confirm the design and integration pattern for each data product is agreed before integration work is planned and scheduled
Consumer experience and adoption

• Run user research and journey mapping with data consumers to find and remove adoption friction

• Track and report adoption and usage metrics: active users, adoption rate, time-to-access, and catalog completeness

• Report adoption results to the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager for value-realization reporting to the executive sponsor
Stakeholder engagement

• Manage data-product owners across multiple P&Ls without formal authority, using clear intake criteria and transparent prioritization

• Coordinate with federated Data Quality Analysts on specification validation and SLA fit by domain

• Brief P&L Data Stewards and Solution Architects ahead of process or standard changes
Required qualifications

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience.

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Data Product Management & Data Marketplace Operations or IT.

• Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.
Eligibility requirement

• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. GE Aerospace will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.
Desired characteristics

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Business (STEM or technical major preferred).

• Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager certification.

• Experience with data quality or data-product SLA and health-score frameworks.

• Working knowledge of data cataloging and self-service access tooling.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Location:
Guardian Corporate Guardian Dentistry Partners is looking for a creative, highly organized, and hands-on Social Media Coordinator to elevate social media across our growing network of dental practices.

At Guardian Dentistry Partners , we support a network of 200+ thriving practices across 15.5 states (shoutout, D.C.!). We’re also proud to have been named in the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies for the fourth consecutive year, ranking No. 2,915 overall and No. 14 among dental companies nationwide.
Our culture is rooted in integrity, collaboration, and purpose, and we believe our success comes from the strength of our partnerships and the people behind them. We bring together passionate, purpose-driven dental entrepreneurs who share a commitment to exceptional care while celebrating the unique qualities that make each partner and practice special.

This role will be dedicated specifically to social media, with a focus on creating engaging, authentic content that brings our individual practices, teams, doctors, and Guardian Dentistry Partners brand to life.

This is not simply a content-scheduling position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable behind the camera, editing Reels and TikToks, identifying trends, coaching local teams, and developing content strategies that can scale across a large organization.

The Social Media Coordinator will manage our social presence while also helping our practices become stronger content creators themselves through training, resources, and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Social Strategy

• Develop and execute social media content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms

• Create engaging short-form video content, including Reels and TikToks

• Film, edit, and publish content featuring doctors, team members, patients when appropriate, office culture, education, technology, recruiting, and brand personality

• Identify relevant social trends and translate them into content appropriate for dental practices and the GDP brand

• Write engaging captions and social copy while maintaining individual practice brand voices

• Build content strategies that balance scalable national content with authentic, office-specific content

• Maintain social content calendars and ensure consistent posting across participating practices

• Monitor performance and use social analytics to continually improve content

Practice Support & Training

• Lead monthly virtual social media trainings and check-ins with participating practices

• Teach office teams how to capture better photos and videos and create engaging social content

• Develop simple content guides, prompts, shot lists, and best practices that make it easy for offices to participate

• Serve as the primary social media resource for practice teams

• Identify offices and team members who are strong content creators and help turn their ideas into scalable examples for the broader organization

On-Site Content Creation

• Travel to each of GDP's eight regions approximately once per year to capture original content

• Plan content shoots in advance to maximize the amount of usable content captured during each visit

• Capture a mix of practice-specific and evergreen content, including educational videos, technology, team culture, recruiting, doctor features, trends, and personality-driven content

• Organize and maintain a content library that can be repurposed across practices and platforms

Social Media Infrastructure

• Support the continued rollout and management of social accounts across GDP practices

• Ensure appropriate access, backup accounts, permissions, and account organization are maintained

• Help establish scalable processes as GDP continues to grow beyond 160 locations

• Partner with the broader marketing team to ensure social supports quarterly campaigns, brand initiatives, recruiting efforts, and practice-level priorities

title: IT Consultant - System Analyst - Cloud CRM

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

title: Managed Care Financial Analytics Director
description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope , where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope ’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. Our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

The Managed Care Financial Analytics Director leads the development of a dedicated analytics capability supporting payer negotiations, contract modeling, reimbursement strategy, payer performance management, and executive reporting across the enterprise. This is a highly strategic role responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that directly influence revenue performance, contract negotiations, and access to care. This leader partners closely across FP&A, IT/Data Governance, Revenue Cycle, Pharmacy, and Contract Administration to build scalable analytics solutions, guide value-based care strategy, and ensure City of Hope is reimbursed appropriately for its specialized care delivery.

As a successful candidate, you will:

• Build and lead a managed care analytics function, establishing scalable processes, standards, and operating models

• Develop financial models to support payer negotiations, renewals, and pricing strategies

• Produce negotiation-ready insights including reimbursement analysis, revenue impact, and margin sensitivity

• Translate payer strategy into data-driven decisions impacting contracts, service lines, and network strategy

• Analyze value-based care performance, bundled payments, and total cost of care models

• Partner cross-functionally to ensure data accuracy, governance, and actionable reporting

• Deliver executive-level dashboards and reporting to guide enterprise decision-making

• Support live negotiations with real-time modeling and financial scenarios

• Identify underperformance, denial trends, and contract compliance risks

• Drive improvements in payer strategy, reimbursement structures, and financial outcomes

Your qualifications should include:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, healthcare administration, or a related field

• 10+ years of experience in healthcare or financial analytics, with managed care expertise

• 5+ years of leadership experience building and managing analytics functions or teams

• Deep knowledge of healthcare finance, payer/provider reimbursement models, and contract structures

• Experience with managed care contracting, pricing strategy, and value-based care models

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with executive presence

• Expertise in contract interpretation, claims data, and healthcare coding methodologies

• Proficiency with analytics tools and platforms (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Epic, or similar)

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives

City of Hope employees’ pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.

City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.

title: QA Testing & Automation Pleno/Senior - COM INGLÊS - Remoto
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO 

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Testes - Testes de Integração e Performance experiente para planejar, projetar e executar testes de integração end-to-end e testes de performance para um programa de Modernização de Automação em larga escala no setor de Energia. A função será responsável por validar integrações entre múltiplas aplicações de negócio, APIs, microsserviços, bancos de dados, plataformas de mensageria e sistemas externos. O Engenheiro de Testes também será responsável por testes de performance, carga, estresse e escalabilidade para garantir que a solução atenda aos requisitos definidos de desempenho e confiabilidade. O candidato selecionado trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o Líder de Testes, Arquitetos de Soluções, Desenvolvedores de Integração, Desenvolvedores de Aplicações, Analistas de Negócios, Product Owners e fornecedores externos para garantir que os processos de negócio end-to-end e as integrações entre sistemas estejam funcionalmente corretos, sejam confiáveis, escaláveis e apresentem bom desempenho.

Visão Geral do Projeto: O programa de Modernização de Automação tem como objetivo modernizar o ecossistema da organização nas áreas de clientes, precificação, previsão, faturamento, integração e analytics por meio de aplicações modernas, integrações API-first, serviços nativos da nuvem e processos de negócio automatizados. Os testes abrangerão processos de negócio end-to-end envolvendo múltiplas plataformas, incluindo Portal do Cliente, CRM, Faturamento, Precificação, Previsão, Gateways de Pagamento, Utilities, Microsoft Fabric, bancos de dados e outras plataformas SaaS e corporativas.

Principais Responsabilidades:
• Desenvolver e executar estratégias, planos, cenários e casos de teste abrangentes para Testes de Integração e Testes de Performance.
• Realizar testes de integração end-to-end entre aplicações, APIs, microsserviços, bancos de dados, plataformas de mensageria e sistemas externos.
• Validar REST APIs, payloads de requisição/resposta, regras de negócio, transformações de dados, tratamento de erros e interfaces entre sistemas.
• Validar integrações síncronas e assíncronas, incluindo APIs, eventos, filas e integrações baseadas em mensagens.
• Realizar validações de banco de dados utilizando SQL para verificar integridade dos dados, reconciliação, transformações e fluxos de dados end-to-end.
• Projetar e executar testes de performance, carga, estresse, resistência, escalabilidade e volume para APIs e aplicações corporativas.
• Desenvolver scripts de testes de performance que simulem transações de negócio, cargas de trabalho, volumes de transações e usuários simultâneos de forma realista.
• Monitorar e analisar tempos de resposta, throughput, concorrência, utilização de recursos, taxas de erro e outras métricas de performance.
• Identificar gargalos de performance em aplicações, integrações, bancos de dados e infraestrutura e colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento e arquitetura na correção desses problemas.
• Criar dados de teste e coordenar dependências de ambientes e dados de teste entre sistemas integrados.

title: Global Payroll Specialist
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Global Payroll Specialist to help build and scale payroll as Legora continues to grow internationally. Working closely with our Global Payroll Manager, you’ll help ensure payroll runs smoothly across multiple countries while also shaping the processes, controls, and ways of working that will support our continued expansion.

This is not a role where you’ll spend most of your time processing payroll yourself. Instead, you’ll coordinate with external payroll providers, review and quality-check their work, and help improve how we work as we enter new markets. As the function develops, there will also be room to shape parts of the role based on your strengths and interests.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Coordinate monthly payroll cycles across multiple countries

- Act as a key contact for external payroll providers

- Make sure payroll is delivered accurately and on time

- Carry out validations, reconciliations, and checks before payroll is finalized

- Help ensure payroll follows local regulations and internal processes

- Support audits by keeping documentation clear and up to date

- Help build and improve payroll processes as we grow into new countries

- Create clear workflows and documentation so our ways of working can scale

- Work with payroll data from HiBob and ensure inputs are accurate and complete

- Partner closely with HR, Finance, and external vendors

- Step in as backup to the Global Payroll Manager when needed

WHO YOU ARE

What matters most is your mindset: you are curious, eager to keep learning, and excited by the opportunity to grow in a global payroll role. We are looking for someone who brings structure, ownership, and a willingness to figure things out in a fast-moving environment.

You also bring:

- 5+ years of payroll experience

- Strong understanding of payroll controls and processes

- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

- Comfortable working with HRIS and payroll systems

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Technical Account Manager, you’ll join 1Password’s Technical Account Management team, helping customers realize long-term value from their investment through implementation, adoption, and ongoing technical guidance. You’ll support complex customer environments, advise on identity, access, device trust, and Software as a Service (SaaS) security, and help shape scalable practices that advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future. This role reports to the Sr. Manager of Technical Account Management and Solution Architects.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate - from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs - creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the US;

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

- Required: 8+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Consultant, ideally in a SaaS or Business-to-Business (B2B) security environment.

- Required: Experience leading technical onboarding and implementation conversations with technical and business stakeholders across complex customer environments.

- Required: Strong communication, storytelling, and demonstration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value.

- Required: Experience with identity technologies and protocols, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), as well as security frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

- Required: Experience with SaaS products, cloud infrastructure, scripting or software development, DevOps practices, and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and command-line interfaces.

- Required: Ability to work autonomously in a remote-first environment, mentor peers, improve team practices, and collaborate effectively across functions.

- Preferred: Experience with 1Password or other password managers, SaaS lifecycle management, Mobile Device Management (MDM), device posture tools, and advising customers on evolv

title: Prakitkant M&A Due Diligence (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena wird von GV unterstützt und macht Immobilien einfacher: von der Wohnungssuche über den Kauf und die Finanzierung bis zur Verwaltung. Dafür kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Technologie und besseren Prozessen weiter. Unser Ziel: Immobilieneigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich machen.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Bevor wir eine Hausverwaltung übernehmen, müssen wir ihr Geschäft verstehen. Wie belastbar sind die Zahlen? Welche Risiken stecken in den Verträgen? Was braucht das Unternehmen, um nach der Übernahme erfolgreich weiterzulaufen?

Als Praktikant:in M&A Due Diligence gehst du diesen Fragen nach. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Deal Lead und unserem Operations- und Deal-Team an laufenden Übernahmen. Dabei begleitest du Transaktionen vom ersten Datenraum über die Bewertung bis zur Entscheidung des Managements und zum Closing.

In unserem dreiköpfigen Team übernimmst du ab Tag eins eigene Workstreams und nimmst an Gesprächen mit den Geschäftsführern der Zielunternehmen teil. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in unsere Kaufentscheidung ein.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Financial DD. Du analysierst BWAs, Jahresabschlüsse und Cashflows, prüfst Umsatz und verwaltete Einheiten und dokumentierst Red Flags. Du arbeitest an Kaufpreismodellen und rechnest Szenarien und Earn-out-Strukturen durch.

- Commercial & Operations DD. Du prüfst Objektlisten, Verwaltungsverträge und ERP-/Prozessdaten. Du bewertest Personal- und Kapazitätsbedarf und bereitest Fragen für die Gespräche mit der Geschäftsleitung vor.

- Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Du verdichtest deine Ergebnisse zu klaren Findings und Executive Summaries. Du bereitest Liegenschaftscontrolling und Liquiditätsplanung auf und lieferst Input für die Entscheidungsvorlage und die Anlagen zum Unternehmenskaufvertrag (SPA).

- Den DD-Prozess steuern. Du erstellst und pflegst Information Request Lists, organisierst den Datenraum in DataSite oder Google Drive und hältst fehlende Unterlagen nach. Du dokumentierst offene Fragen, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse in Linear.

- Eigene Workstreams verantworten. Je nach Erfahrung und Transaktion führst du einzelne DD-Workstreams von der ersten Datenanforderung bis zum Findings-Report.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Bereits ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder transaktionsnaher Beratung absolviert hast.

- BWL, VWL, Finance, Accounting, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder etwas Vergleichbares studierst - ab dem fünften Semester oder im Master.

- GuV, BWA und Bilanz sicher lesen kannst und verstehst, was Umsatz, EBITDA, Working Capital und Verbindlichkeiten über ein Unternehmen aussagen.

- Bewertungsmethoden wie Multiples und DCF kennst und bereits angewendet hast.

- Excel sicher beherrschst: Pivot-Tabellen, XVERWEIS/SVERWEIS und das Aufbereiten und Konsolidieren unstrukturierter Daten.

- Sorgfältig arbeitest, Unstimmigkeiten hinterfragst und offene Punkte eigenständig klärst.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sprichst und schreibst. Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, Verträge und Finanzunterlagen sind überwiegend deutsch.

- Für mindestens drei, idealerweise sechs Monate Vollzeit verfügbar bist und aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten möchtest.

WAS DU BEI UNS LERNST

- Wie wir als Käufer Unternehmen prüfen, bewerten und übernehmen - bei einer zweistelligen Anzahl an Transaktionen pro Jahr.

- Wie aus Finanzdaten, Verträgen und Management-Gesprächen eine belastbare Kaufentscheidung entsteht.

- Wie Bewertung, Kaufvertrag und spätere Integration zusammenhängen.

Bei guter Zusammenarbeit gibt es eine Perspektive für den Einstieg nach dem Praktikum.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget pro Monat und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget

UofL Health is a fully integrated regional academic health system with five hospitals, four medical centers, nearly 200 physician practice locations, more than 700 providers, the Frazier Rehab Institute and Brown Cancer Center.
With more than 12,000 team members-physicians, surgeons, nurses, pharmacists and other highly skilled health care professionals- UofL Health is focused on one mission: delivering patient-centered care to each and every patient each and every day. Job Description:

The position works closely with the UofL Health Clinical Research Review Committee (CRRC); the Interdisciplinary Research Oversight Council (IROC), the Research Regulatory Coordinator, the UofL Human Subjects Protection Program and External Institutional Review Boards (IRB). The Research Regulatory Coordinator Sr establishes standard operating procedures as needed to streamline operations and increase effectiveness and efficiency with the ULHRO team members and service line leaders. • Develop processes and procedures as needed to streamline regulatory oversight in the UofL Health Facilities and ULP clinics

The VP, Business Development will develop and execute a disciplined sales strategy targeting insurance carriers, MGAs, captives, brokers, self-insured entities, and public sector clients. This leader will build and manage a business development team, establish strategic partnerships, represent Venbrook Claims in the market, and collaborate closely with operations, marketing, and executive leadership to position the organization for sustained, scalable growth. The ideal candidate brings deep insurance industry relationships, a track record of closing complex, multi-service sales in the claims or TPA space, and the executive presence to represent Venbrook Claims at the highest levels.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sales Leadership & Revenue Ownership: Demonstrated ability to build and lead a business development function from strategy through execution. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a complex B2B services environment, with ownership of the full sales lifecycle from pipeline development through contract close.

Insurance Industry Expertise: Deep knowledge of the claims and TPA marketplace, including third party administration, complex claims management, independent adjusting, and specialty lines. Established relationships with decision-makers at insurance carriers, MGAs, captives, brokers, and self-insured organizations.

Strategic Market Development: Ability to identify, evaluate, and pursue new market opportunities across product lines, geographies, and client segments. Translates market intelligence and competitive dynamics into actionable sales strategy aligned with organizational priorities.

Client Relationship Management: Executive-level relationship development skills with the ability to cultivate and maintain long-term partnerships with C-suite and senior operational stakeholders. Skilled at navigating complex procurement processes and multi-stakeholder decision environments.

Team Building & Leadership: Experience recruiting, developing, and leading business development and sales teams. Provides coaching, direction, and accountability to team members while fostering a performance-driven, client-focused culture.

Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to develop and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and capability presentations to senior decision-makers. Represents Venbrook Claims with credibility and professionalism in all market-facing settings.

CRM & Pipeline Management: Advanced proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms. Skilled at building accurate pipeline forecasts, tracking team performance metrics, and delivering data-driven reporting to executive leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with claims operations, finance, marketing, and technology teams to ensure seamless client onboarding, service delivery, and relationship continuity. What you will do:
As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.
We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.
Who we’re looking for:

• U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.

• Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.

• Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.

• People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

• Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.

• Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

• A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.

• For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.

• Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.

• ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?
No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

• Current resume (PDF)

• Cover letter (PDF)

• A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a Digital Experience Lead to help drive its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role focused on improving conversion across our landing pages and customer journeys.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way. With significant investment across paid acquisition, getting the experience right from the moment a customer lands with us is critical.

You’ll work closely with SEM, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to understand customer behaviour, identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into experiments and improvements that drive measurable commercial impact.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics - including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data - accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're seeking engineers to utilize advanced technology in agile settings, with a focus on improving the customer experience for every collector.

Collectors Cybersecurity team is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand.

We’re looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and drive secure by default architectures and ensure the security and integrity of our infrastructure.
You’ll join our Cybersecurity Team and work from our Santa Ana, CA office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do:

•
Drive Detection Engineering: Build, tune and manage high-confidence detections across cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), enterprise tooling (Okta, GWS, M365) and vendor products. Treat detections as code: version controlled, peer reviewed, tested in CI, and measured for precision and coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.

•
Incident Command and Containment: Serve as a senior responder for security incidents, driving triage, containment, forensics, and remediation, and authoring post-incident reviews that turn lessons into durable improvements.

•
Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat hunts across cloud, SaaS, identity and on-prem infrastructure, converting hypotheses and findings into new detections and hardened controls.

•
Tooling and Response Automation: Design and build automation and SOAR playbooks that reduce manual toil, accelerate response times, and improve alert enrichment and case management.

•
Security Telemetry : Own and improve the health of the security data pipeline

title: Debit Card Dispute Specialist - Remote (Florida)

title: Credit Risk Analyst Commercial Underwriter
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team is responsible for managing the credit risk generated by businesses processing payments on Stripe. The team combines commercial underwriting, portfolio management, analytics, and cross-functional partnership to protect Stripe from financial loss while enabling strong businesses to grow. The APAC Credit Risk team supports a diverse portfolio of businesses across the region. We partner closely with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Operations, and other Risk teams to make sound, timely credit decisions and develop scalable approaches to managing risk.

What you’ll do

You will underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC. You will evaluate complex business models and financial information, develop clear credit recommendations, and identify mitigations that protect Stripe while supporting sustainable user growth.

Responsibilities

• Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC.

• Build expertise across APAC industries, geographies, payment flows, and operating models, and apply this context to underwriting and portfolio decisions.

• Conduct periodic and trigger-based reviews, identify changes in risk, and recommend timely actions to manage Stripe’s exposure.

• Support the refinement of systems, tools, and processes to help the team deliver on key performance indicators, such as credit loss targets or portfolio coverage metrics.

• Communicate credit decisions, risk considerations, and mitigation requirements clearly to internal stakeholders and to users, including CFOs and CEOs.

• Partner with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Risk teams to resolve complex cases and improve Stripe’s credit-risk capabilities.

• Identify recurring portfolio trends and underwriting gaps, and translate these insights into improvements to policies, controls, and decision frameworks.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial credit underwriting, financial-risk modeling, cash-flow forecasting, or portfolio credit risk.

• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong accounting knowledge and demonstrated ability to evaluate financial statements, cash flows, business models, and sources of repayment.

• Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into a clear credit-risk narrative, approval rationale, and mitigation strategy.

• Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance financial-risk considerations with user growth and business objectives.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex credit decisions to senior inter

ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: This role is for the PFAS team which sits within SandboxAQ's Chemical Simulation (ChemSim) group. Our mission is to develop PFAS-lean or PFAS-free substitutes and formulations for semiconductor process and fab materials that meet both performance specifications and environmental and safety requirements in complex semiconductor manufacturing environments. We combine generative ML, physics based simulation (e.g. DFT and molecular dynamics), Large Quantitative Models for property prediction, and multi-scale modeling with a partner driven experimental validation loop. You will work alongside industrial co-development partners to move candidate molecules from prediction to qualified use.

Introduction to the role: The PFAS team is hiring Machine Learning Scientists to own machine learned force fields (MLFFs) for the PFAS substitution programme, including generating the first principles data they are trained on. Machine learned potentials are the load bearing element of our discovery pipeline: the properties that decide whether a candidate molecule can replace a PFAS incumbent - among them reactivity, thermal stability, and the diffusivity through polymer matrices - are ones that the physics based simulations can compute accurately but far too slowly to screen a library, and that classical force fields compute quickly but may not be accurate enough to trust. In this role you will: (1) design and run the high-throughput quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics campaigns that produce our training data, and own the infrastructure that makes them reproducible; (2) train, validate, and deploy the potentials that data supports, and identify where each model's domain of validity ends; and (3) extend machine learned potentials into the chemistry that PFAS substitution requires.

Stand up automated, restartable, provenance tracked workflows across cloud and HPC by collaborating with the engineering team; curate and version the resulting datasets, and combine internally generated first-principles data with relevant public molecular and materials datasets under consistent conventions.

We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. You’ll lead Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives, improve our Okta environment, and help expand Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows across IT. Your work will make secure access simpler and more reliable, helping advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. • Demonstrate experience applying AI to accelerate or replace team workflows, while managing project timelines, risks, stakeholder communication, and organizational change.

What you can expect:

• Operate and improve Okta, including tenant configuration, policies, lifecycle management, and complex identity issues.

• Lead IAM initiatives from concept through rollout, including role-based access control, access reviews, and onboarding and offboarding automation.

• Build safeguards that make identity and access changes safer to deploy and easier to audit.

• Design durable application integrations

title: Founding Engineer
description: Subimage (YC W25) | Founding Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE (5 days/week) | Full-time | $170K-$230K + 0.5%-1.0% equity | https://subimage.io Hihi, I'm Alex, co-founder and CEO. Subimage maps infrastructure the way an attacker does so security teams at scale-ups and enterprises can find and fix problems. We're built on Cartography ( https://cartography.dev ), the open source infra mapping tool we helped create at Lyft and donated to the CNCF. It runs at over 70 companies, including 7 in the Fortune 100. We're a tiny seed-stage team and our customers are companies your parents have heard of. We have more demand than we can build for, which is why this post exists. This is a chance to get in on the ground floor of something big (or to find out quickly that it won't work; just being upfront about it). Some of the problems you'd be working on: - Vulnerability triage with real context: is the asset internet-facing, through which services, is the vulnerable function actually reachable in code, are there compensating controls, and what sensitive data does it reach once exploited, across how many hops. - Proving that the security fixes our agent proposes won't break anything. - A near-real-time, self-updating map of an environment so you can see an attack as it happens, plus "time travel" in the graph so you can replay it afterward. - Teaching an agent to answer questions about a large graph quickly, with only the context it needs and without making mistakes. - Determining who owns a given resource from messy signals like tags, actions, logs, and files. Stack: Cartography for ingestion, Neo4j for the graph, Python/FastAPI backend, Svelte frontend with a homegrown WebGL graph renderer, an MCP server that exposes all of it to agents, Terraform for IaC. Who we're looking for: 3+ years at high-growth companies, strong distributed systems and cloud experience, a real sense of ownership, first-principles thinking, and a willingness to implement gnarly business logic (elegantly, ideally) if it makes a jaded security engineer's life easier. Kubernetes and security knowledge are nice to have, not required. You're in the Bay Area and want to be in the office five days a week. Process: technical screen, call with the founders, a paid day working with the team, then offer. Health/vision/dental, 401k match, gym, team lunches, unlimited PTO. • Managing the Information Security policy lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, updating, tracking approvals, and supporting periodic reviews.

• Supporting and enhancing security awareness and education initiatives through communications, campaigns, training content, and reporting.

• Maintaining GRC processes, procedures, methodologies, and performance metrics while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Providing guidance and mentoring to less-experienced analysts and promoting consistent GRC practices across the organization.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
DELIVERY MANAGER

Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.

Salary: £45,000 - £80,000

SC Clearance Requirements:

Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for all our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. In future, DV clearance may be required, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

You must be UK-based.

ABOUT US

We are experts in building central cloud platforms, cloud risk mitigation and cloud operating models, providing thought leadership to central government and private enterprise organisations to help them unlock the true value of cloud.

 

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

At Cloudscaler, you'll be part of a consultancy at the forefront of cloud transformation, trusted by government, defence, and enterprise organisations to deliver complex AWS solutions that make a real national impact. From modernising public services to securing critical infrastructure, the work you do will matter far beyond technology.

We combine the agility of a startup with the credibility of an AWS Advanced Partner, creating a high-trust, high-performance culture where self-starters thrive and every voice is heard. You'll work closely with senior leadership and cloud experts, shaping meaningful projects and driving innovation.

By joining us, you'll accelerate your personal and professional development through hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud solutions. You'll learn directly from experts while contributing to some of the UK's most ambitious cloud programmes, gaining exposure and influence you wouldn't find in a larger consultancy.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Cloudscaler is growing. We are winning more cloud engagements across public and private sector, and we need delivery professionals who can take ownership of engagements and see them through. This role exists to make sure our client work is delivered on time, within scope, and to the standard that has built our reputation. You will report to the Chief Delivery Officer and work alongside Lead and Senior Delivery Managers across Cloudscaler’s client portfolio.

The role is client-facing and hands-on. It suits someone who has already delivered a complex technology programme end to end and wants to grow their consulting and stakeholder skills in a supportive team.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience delivering at complex technology-led programme end to end. Datacentre migration, infrastructure or cloud transformation is preferred over generic programme management.

- Hands-on experience producing delivery reporting and artefacts (status reports, RAID logs, plans and roadmaps) using tooling such as Jira, Confluence or equivalent.

- Experience in a consulting environment, or an internal role with a strong client-facing delivery element.

- Confident working with client stakeholders; you can run a project meeting, influence people who do not report to you, and have honest conversations about scope, timeline or risk, knowing when to escalate.

- Experience delivering AWS-based engagements; hands-on AWS experience is not essential provided you understand core cloud infrastructure concepts.

- Experience working in or running agile delivery teams (Scrum, Kanban or hybrid).

- Experience of public sector delivery and familiarity with government digital service standards.

- Understanding of cloud migration approaches and the delivery challenges involved in moving and modernising workloads.

- Some exposure to pre-sales, estimation or scoping work.

- Relevant qualifications are a plus but not essential: PRINCE2,

description:
Sobre a

A GIRO.TECH é uma fintech que atua como uma plataforma de originação e distribuição de crédito para correspondentes bancários, combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência de mercado. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e o nosso combustível são os desafios trazidos por nossos parceiros. Com nossa expertise de negócios, simplificamos a jornada de crédito e habilitamos novas receitas financeiras para que empresas e varejistas ofereçam crédito de forma eficiente.
Aqui todos precisam ter o conhecimento dos instrumentos que viabilizam essa engrenagem. Portanto, prepare-se para aprender a fundo como funcionam FIDCs, Securitizadoras e soluções tecnológicas para a originação e distribuição de crédito.
Nossas soluções são integradas e invisíveis: por meio de APIs robustas, nossos parceiros acoplam nossa tecnologia de intermediação diretamente nos serviços que já prestam. É aí que reside um dos nossos maiores desafios: cada parceiro possui um ambiente de sistemas diferente, com cenários técnicos particulares. Cada desafio é único, e temos enorme satisfação em arquitetar e desenvolver a solução de integração ideal.
Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)
Valorizamos quem temBRIO!
Somos uma empresa formada por NERDS apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos do mercado financeiro. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito : não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.
Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.
Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje como sócios da empresa , muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.
Fundadores - nossa base
Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Isso é GIRO.TECH

•
Liderança e Mentoria: aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.

•
Voz Ativa: a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.

•
Liberdade e Responsabilidade: valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.

•
Crescimento Interno: priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.

•
Excelência Técnica: nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

• Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
